findings.evidence: `rg killCompl_X` over ./mathlib hits only `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Rename.lean:265,269`; `rg killCompl_X_of_notMem_range` over ./code returns nothing; both proofs are `rw [X]; exact killCompl_monomial_eq_zero_of_notMem_range … (s := Finsupp.single _ 1) 1 (by simp) …`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem MvPolynomial.killCompl_X_of_notMem_range (hf) {a : τ} (ha : a ∉ Set.range f) : killCompl hf (X a) = 0` to this file (the PR description already names it), use it for `hX` here and in `simplyBlockedRingHom_X_eq_zero`, and list it in the module docstring.
findings.issue: `killCompl hf (X a) = 0` for `a ∉ Set.range f` is general infrastructure, proved inline here (`hX`, lines 67–70) and again verbatim in `TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid/SimplyBlocked.lean:100–103` (`simplyBlockedRingHom_X_eq_zero`); Mathlib has it only for `MvPowerSeries` (`MvPowerSeries.killCompl_X_eq_zero`), not `MvPolynomial`. Because it is not a public `@[simp]` lemma, `simp` cannot close `simplyBlockedRingHom R i (X i) = 0` after unfolding the `abbrev`, which is exactly why the author had to leave `simplyBlockedRingHom_X_eq_zero` non-simp.

summary: The prior gap is closed: `IsKnot.exact_X_smul_simplyBlockedHomologyMap` and `IsKnot.exact_simplyBlockedHomologyδ_X_smul` now expose the `R[U]` sequence on `hG.simplyBlockedHomology`. Two surface defects remain: a general `killCompl (X a) = 0` lemma is inlined twice instead of exported (leaving `simplyBlockedRingHom_X_eq_zero` outside `simp`), and one public lemma duplicates Mathlib's `ModuleCat.restrictScalars.smul_def`.
